title: How to clean a washing machine filter

pieces.say: That little door on your washer? Almost nobody opens it.
pieces.text: That little door on your washer? Almost nobody opens it.
pieces.label: HIDDEN DOOR

pieces.say: Here's the hidden part. Behind it sits the pump filter.
Unplug it, let any hot water cool, and open the flap.
Put a tray down and slowly unscrew the filter.
Pull out the lint and coins, then rinse it.
Expect more water than you think.
pieces.text: Hot water? Let it cool first.

pieces.say: No more slow draining or funky smells.

result.say: No more slow draining or funky smells.
result.headline: Drains like new

pieces.say: Daily hidden cleaning hacks, at hiddenclean dot com.
